market.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (research/educational use; see docs/dataset_notes.md)

timezone_assumptions: datetime64 input carried timezone UTC; converted to UTC instants
notes: no imputation or forward-fill: missing prices stay missing, and non-trading days simply have no row (invariant 3)
each row is one exchange session; the timestamp is a UTC date stamp for that session, not an intraday instant

timezone_assumptions: the source publishes a calendar date only; published_at is midnight UTC of that date and the time of day is unknown
notes: available_from = published_at + 1 day; use it (not published_at) for feature cutoffs so day-level timestamps cannot leak same-day, post-cutoff news (invariant 2)
article_text is the source's short_description field (the dataset has no body text)
source_category is the publisher's own label, kept separate from our event taxonomy
publisher taken from the article URL (host, 'www.' stripped); no fallback label is configured, so an article without a URL keeps a missing source
article_id is derived (SHA-1 of source_url|headline|date), not a source field
duplicates removed: 0 identical article_id, 0 identical headline+date
event_category, sentiment_label, sentiment_score and affected_sector are intentionally unassigned in Phase 1 and are reported as missing rather than filled with placeholders
no headline text was rewritten, truncated, or normalised beyond trimming surrounding whitespace

summary.class_balance_note: Phase 1 has no prediction target yet, so target class balance is reported in Phase 3. Event-category balance depends on the Phase 2 annotation step; the single 'POLITICS' source category is a filter, not our taxonomy.

checks.name: market_chronological
checks.detail: timestamps are strictly ascending after cleaning; no shuffling

checks.name: market_no_imputation
checks.detail: no values imputed or forward-filled; reported missing cells: none

checks.name: news_published_at_parsed
checks.detail: 0 row(s) dropped as unparsable before cleaning; 0 unparsable remain

checks.name: news_available_from_after_published_at
checks.detail: every article is available from the day after its (day-precision) publication date, so a same-day cutoff cannot leak post-cutoff news

checks.name: market_news_windows_overlap
checks.detail: 887 calendar day(s) present in both tables, first 2018-01-02 last 2022-09-19

limitations: News timestamps are day-level: time of day is unknown, so features must use available_from (Phase 4).
The source is general-interest political news, not a curated geopolitical corpus; a source category filter does not make every headline geopolitical.
Only one instrument (SPY) is covered in Phase 1; sector or multi-symbol coverage is out of scope for now.
event_category and sentiment columns are intentionally empty until Phase 2.
Coverage differs between the two tables where configured dates differ; overlapping coverage is reported above.
Market data comes from Yahoo Finance via yfinance and is used for research/education only; see docs/dataset_notes.md.
next_step: Phase 2 — define the event taxonomy, then label a small reviewed sample and classify headlines.
